C-LOCALE-MIN-TWIN-REMOVAL.Name: Locale min-twin removal: one full-table locale pipeline for runtime, tests and release tooling
C-LOCALE-MIN-TWIN-REMOVAL.Summary: Every locale ships twice: static/locales/<code>.json is the full human-editable table and <code>.min.json is its byte-compacted one-line twin (560,622 bytes across ten languages). The runtime reads only the twins (localeLoader.js import.meta.glob), a unit test enforces byte-parity between twin and source, and every translated-string change must rewrite ten one-line files — so a change whose real locale edit is 13,128 bytes produces a 1,131,587-byte textual diff (git diff over static/locales on commit c65c534a, 2026-10-27; the ten twins alone contribute 1,118,459 bytes), which repeatedly breaks the owner's agent push budgets (owner report 2026-10-28, originally in Russian: "the budget is exceeded again; two commits each rewrite 20 locale files, over 2 MB in total"). The min-twin scheme is dead weight in the Tauri architecture: it originated as a network-fetch optimization in the Electron ancestor (static/ copied 1:1 from mark-electron@v1.2.3 in commit 02cb6a9f, 2026-04-28; upstream marktext commits no twins — its minification scheme is the uncommitted build-time scripts/minify-locales.ts, exactly the generate-at-build alternative the owner rejected; verified 2026-10-28), the fetch it served was replaced by bundled lazy chunks in 2026-10-14, and the manual twin-regeneration step is already a recorded pain point (tests/e2e/settings-tabs-content.spec.ts comment: "until the .min.json regeneration runs"). The owner reviewed the analysis and approved removal on 2026-10-28 (owner decision, originally in Russian: "remove the twins outright; do not generate them at build time"). This change switches the runtime loader, all test readers and the release tooling to the full tables, deletes the ten twins plus a guard so the category cannot silently return, and deletes the dead src/common/i18n.js (zero importers, verified by repo-wide grep on 2026-10-28).

Problem.Description: (1) Duplicated storage with a byte-parity law: ten full tables (689,495 bytes) plus ten one-line twins (560,622 bytes) live in git, and tests/renderer/i18n/locale-keys.test.js ("keeps every minimized twin byte-identical to the compact source", 2026-10-27) makes every locale edit a mandatory twin rewrite — a second value-level parity law lives in tests/renderer/components/updateNotice.test.js ("the compact .min.json tables stay in sync"). (2) Diff explosion: a one-line twin is a single line, so a git text diff replaces the whole 49-76 KB line per language; ten languages turn a 13,128-byte semantic edit into a 1,131,587-byte diff (c65c534a), breaking agent push budgets and making review noise. (3) Manual regeneration debt: twins are regenerated by an ad-hoc step outside the build (only tools/release-normalize.mjs rewrites them, and only during a version bump); tests/e2e/settings-tabs-content.spec.ts documents a spec left degraded "until the .min.json regeneration runs". (4) Dead code: src/common/i18n.js still reads static/locales/<code>.min.json from disk for a main-process consumer that no longer exists — repo-wide grep on 2026-10-28 finds zero importers (node_modules and build output excluded), so it is a false lead for every future editor. (5) Stale rationale: the twins optimized an Electron fetch that was replaced on 2026-10-14 by import.meta.glob lazy chunks (V-M-055 scenario-1); nothing at runtime benefits from the compaction today — one locale chunk loads once per session and the full table is only 12.8-13 KB larger (12,818-13,032 bytes).

Goals.R-1: Runtime: localeLoader.js switches its import.meta.glob from static/locales/*.min.json to static/locales/*.json; BUNDLED_LOCALES keeps resolving the same ten codes (codeOf strips the plain .json suffix); lazy per-locale chunks, the missing-locale fallback, the {} broken-load fallback, both log markers and the English static import stay behaviourally identical; MODULE_CONTRACT DEPENDS lines and stale min.json comments in the touched i18n files (localeLoader.js, systemLocale.js, _shims/install-window-globals.js) are updated to the full-table pipeline in the same edit.
Goals.R-2: Twin deletion with a guard: the ten static/locales/*.min.json files are deleted from the repository; .gitignore gains the static/locales/*.min.json pattern; tests/renderer/i18n/locale-keys.test.js retires its byte-parity law and gains a guard asserting that static/locales contains exactly the ten expected .json tables and no *.min.json file (a reintroduced twin fails CI naming the file); the file's three C-TITLEBAR-MODE-CHIPS T-003 content gates (fifteen modeChips families, non-empty native copy, truncation range) are retained verbatim — only the parity block is replaced — and the file's MODULE_CONTRACT PURPOSE and MODULE_MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY wording (which stale-count "seventeen" families against the asserted fifteen), and its stale active-path LINKS line (the referenced change is archived) are refreshed in the same edit; the retired parity check and its rationale are recorded in design-context.xml.
Goals.R-3: Test readers, classified by what they actually do (inventory at spec time, 2026-10-28 repo-wide grep, node_modules and build output excluded; the plan re-runs the grep and covers anything missed): switched readers — tests/renderer/i18n/locale-loader.test.js (reads every twin; switches to the full tables), tests/renderer/i18n/system-language.test.js (a "(min.json)" test title at line 135; retitle); deliberately retired tests — tests/renderer/components/updateNotice.test.js lines 203-217 (a second, value-level min/full sync law; retired, not switched); dead filter clauses and stale comments deleted — tests/renderer/store/notification.test.ts:118, tests/renderer/util/theme-families-docs-macos.test.js:338, tests/e2e/table-ui-regressions.spec.ts:47, tests/renderer/util/theme-contrast.test.js:275 (all four are .min.json exclusion filters that become no-ops once the twins are gone), tests/renderer/util/agent-prompt-rich.test.js:14 and tests/renderer/whatsNew/content.test.js:13 (comments describing twin regeneration), tests/e2e/settings-tabs-content.spec.ts (stale regeneration comment); assertions other than the retired parity laws are unchanged.
Goals.R-4: Release tooling: tools/release-normalize.mjs stops emitting minPath changes (the PLAN_RELEASE_NORMALIZATION block writes only the full source tables); tools/release-materials.mjs stops reading minifiedTables, and validateLocaleMaterials' source-to-minified parity requirement (the stableJson comparison failing as MT_RELEASE_LOCALE_MIN_DRIFT) is dropped deliberately — locale-materials validation continues against the full source tables alone; tests/renderer/release-normalize.test.js and tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js are updated to the new fixture shape in the same bundle.
Goals.R-5: Dead code removal: src/common/i18n.js is deleted; it has zero importers (verified 2026-10-28) and no MODULE_CONTRACT or graph entry, so no graph removal is required — the plan re-verifies both facts before deleting and re-runs typecheck:ipc after.
Goals.R-6: Governance: every living graph, verification and context artifact whose text names min twins is updated in the same bundle — spec-time grep inventory (2026-10-28): graph/features.xml M-055 Summary, verification/features.xml V-M-055 scenarios, graph/runtime.xml M-011 (lines 2823, 3051-3054, 3074: "json + min.json" phrasing, the "source/minified locale catalogs" passage, and the release-materials source-to-min parity claim), verification/runtime.xml V-M-011 (lines 4135, 4964, 5153), V-M-012 (lines 6192, 6690, 6789), V-M-062 line 13010 (its scenario-locale-parity text asserts the byte-parity law this change retires and miscounts "seventeen" families against the asserted fifteen; both corrected, and its Commands list includes locale-keys.test.js), and .grace/context/deployment.xml line 1067 (a living "Regen *.min.json" instruction); the R-3 test-file edits inside other anchors' Commands lists are observed writes under those anchors and any anchor whose scenario text names twins is updated likewise; frozen history is untouched by protocol — docs/*.xml provenance (docs/development-plan.xml line 1769 carries a "Regen *.min.json" step) and .grace/changes/archive/** keep their wording and are covered by the .grace/changes/** exclusion in the acceptance criteria's residue grep; after the code lands, a re-grep of .grace/graph/, .grace/verification/ and .grace/context/ must return zero min.json hits; no new module id is claimed; grace lint --assertions current shows no new errors beyond the recorded pre-existing baseline after archiving.

Constraints.Item: No translation-content changes: the ten full tables' keys, values and ordering are untouched; this change deletes generated duplicates and switches readers, it never edits locale copy.

No new build step or runtime dependency is introduced — the generate-at-build alternative (keep twins out of git, regenerate on build) is explicitly rejected by the owner on 2026-10-28; the accepted size impact is twofold: full-table lazy chunks 12.8-13 KB larger per locale (one chunk loaded per session) and the installed locale payload growing by 66,168 bytes, against a 560,622-byte git-footprint reduction.

No loader-semantics change beyond the file set: lazy per-locale chunks, the English static import, the {} fallbacks and both [i18n][loadLocaleTable] log markers stay identical; systemLocale.js SHIPPED_LOCALES parity is unchanged.
Language: every committed artifact is English; owner quotes are translated with speaker and date, the Russian chat originals stay owner-side material referenced by description only.
No private or ephemeral absolute paths in committed artifacts; measurements and commit ids are cited by value.

Existing gates stay green and unweakened: npm test, the e2e projects used by the VerificationIntent, typecheck:ipc, grace lint --assertions current vs the recorded baseline; the shared-worktree parallel work is sequenced with a grace lint --parallel-preflight re-run before the first write, not trusted.

Desktop and MAS lanes behave identically: both bundle locale tables through the same loader; no lane-specific handling is added and no packaging manifest change is required (tauri.conf.json carries no per-file static resources entry — verified 2026-10-28).

No release, train admission or version bump follows from approval: version changes and publication stay behind the separate owner release workflow; docs/release-process.md is touched only if it references min twins, which the plan verifies.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Generating min twins at build time or restoring them in any form (owner decision 2026-10-28); the .gitignore pattern and the R-2 guard exist precisely to keep them out.
Changing the locale file format (YAML, flat keys, per-namespace files), the locale inventory, the key inventory or any translation content.
Any i18n behaviour change beyond the file set: lazy-loading strategy, English static import, system-locale resolution, language switching flows are untouched.
Mobile lane surfaces; any mobile work.

Creating plan.xml or implementing any R-item in the spec pass; claiming any new module id — every edit lives in existing module scope: the loader and its tests under M-055, the release tools under M-046, and the governance text of the M-011/M-012/M-062 anchors whose records name twins.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Runtime equivalence: BUNDLED_LOCALES resolves the same ten locale codes from the full tables; loadLocaleTable returns the identical translation objects for all ten locales; the missing-locale and broken-load fallbacks still return {} with the same [i18n][loadLocaleTable] markers; a running build switches UI language across all ten locales exactly as before the change.

No twins anywhere: static/locales contains exactly ten files, all full .json tables; the .gitignore carries the static/locales/*.min.json pattern; the locale-keys guard test fails if any *.min.json reappears or if a locale table is missing; a repo-wide grep for the string "min.json" in both dotted and bare forms (node_modules, build output and .grace/changes/** excluded — active bundles are working documents and final assertions run before archiving) returns only the guard test itself, the .gitignore entry and frozen history (docs/*.xml provenance such as docs/development-plan.xml); living documentation (CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/engineering-protocol.md, docs/release-process.md, .grace/context/*.xml) is swept clean.

Tests: the full vitest suite is green with every reader switched and every dead filter clause and stale comment deleted; both parity laws are retired deliberately (locale-keys' byte-parity block, updateNotice's min/full sync test) while locale-keys' three T-003 content gates are retained verbatim with a refreshed LINKS path; tests/renderer/release-normalize.test.js and tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js pass against the new tooling shape.

Release tooling: a release-normalize dry run over its fixture emits full-table changes only and no min twin paths; release-materials validates locale materials against the full tables; both tools' own suites are part of the green run.

Dead code: src/common/i18n.js no longer exists; a repo-wide grep finds no reference resolving to src/common/i18n.js or to its exported functions (path-scoped: the renderer's window.i18nUtils.loadTranslations is an unrelated symbol and must not be flagged); typecheck:ipc stays clean.

Governance: every living graph/verification/context artifact from the R-6 spec-time inventory (M-055/V-M-055, M-011/V-M-011, V-M-012, V-M-062, .grace/context/deployment.xml — the M-046 edits are tool code and its tests, not graph text) is updated in the same bundle with no remaining min.json text; frozen history keeps its wording as the named exceptions; the graph, verification and code edits ship in one bundle; grace lint --assertions current reports no new errors beyond the recorded pre-existing baseline.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: npx vitest run tests/renderer/i18n/ tests/renderer/release-normalize.test.js tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js tests/renderer/whatsNew/content.test.js; npm test; npx playwright test tests/e2e/settings-tabs-content.spec.ts tests/e2e/table-ui-regressions.spec.ts --project=chromium; npm run typecheck:ipc; grace lint --path . --assertions current
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit: i18n suites green over the full tables incl. the ten-file guard; release tool suites green over the twin-free fixture shape. E2E: the two i18n-dependent specs pass on chromium with locale strings rendered from full tables. Residue check: a repo-wide grep for "min.json" in both dotted and bare forms (node_modules, build output and .grace/changes/** excluded) returns only the guard test, the .gitignore entry and the named frozen-history exceptions. Gates: npm test fully green; typecheck:ipc clean; grace lint shows no new errors beyond the recorded baseline (pre-existing heuristic-confidence and C-PAGE-WIDTH-TABLES overlap warnings unchanged). Content-free markers: the existing [i18n][loadLocaleTable][BLOCK_LOCALE_MISSING] and [i18n][loadLocaleTable][BLOCK_LOCALE_LOAD_FAILED] markers remain the runtime evidence, unchanged.

Assumptions.Assumption: Owner decisions of 2026-10-28 are the design base, cited as decisions not proposals: remove the twins outright rather than regenerate them at build time, and delete the dead src/common/i18n.js in the same change. Original Russian quotes stay owner-side; English translations with speaker and date appear in Summary.

The twin scheme's origin and irrelevance are verified facts, not narrative: static/ was copied 1:1 from mark-electron@v1.2.3 (commit 02cb6a9f, 2026-04-28, commit body names the copy); upstream marktext's static/locales contains no twins (checked on GitHub 2026-10-28); the fetch the twins optimized was replaced by bundled lazy chunks on 2026-10-14 (V-M-055 scenario-1 records the 404 history).

The min-twin reader inventory outside node_modules and build output maps onto this bundle's ownership (repo-wide grep 2026-10-28): the R-3 classification (one switched reader file, one retitle, one retired sync test, seven dead filter clauses or stale comments), the R-2 reader inside locale-keys.test.js, the R-4 tool fixtures inside release-normalize.test.js and release-materials.test.js, the two tools themselves, and the dead src/common/i18n.js; the plan re-runs the grep after the bundle lands to prove nothing was missed.

The size impact is bounded and two-sided: a full table exceeds its twin by 12,818-13,032 bytes per locale, English is already statically imported as the full table (i18n/index.js), so nine lazy chunks grow once; no Tauri config ships static/ as files (bundle.resources is absent; vite publicDir points elsewhere), so the installed locale payload moves from 623,327 bytes (ten twin chunks plus the static full English table) to 689,495 bytes — a 66,168-byte growth accepted against the 560,622-byte git-footprint reduction.

Min-twin text in living governance artifacts extends beyond M-055/M-046 — the spec-time grep inventory of 2026-10-28 (graph/runtime.xml M-011 lines 2823, 3051-3054, 3074; verification/runtime.xml V-M-011 lines 4135, 4964, 5153, V-M-012 lines 6192, 6690, 6789, V-M-062 line 13010; .grace/context/deployment.xml line 1067) is owned by R-6, and the plan re-greps .grace/graph/, .grace/verification/ and .grace/context/ after landing; frozen history (docs/*.xml provenance, archive bundles) keeps its wording by protocol and is excepted by name in the acceptance criteria.
